name: HYDRA-UMC-BRIDGE-DROIDS
notes: Real, dependency-free coordination boundary for legged/humanoid droids: validates a small named action-trigger vocabulary (WALK_TO/PICK_OBJECT/PLACE_OBJECT/RETURN_HOME/HOLD_POSITION/STAND/SIT) and its real required parameters before forwarding through HYDRA-UMC-SDK's shared safety gate, plus a real bosdyn-client command sender (SpotDroidControl) for Boston Dynamics Spot, lazily imported. Never computes gait/balance/joint trajectories itself - that authority stays with the droid's own onboard controller. Not yet exercised against a real Spot robot.
